# Project Maya — Technical Summary

## What it is
Project Maya is a free, open-source local inference engine for large MoE models (GLM-5.3-Flash, DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017, MiniMax-M3.1-Flash) on consumer hardware. It tiers model experts across VRAM → pinned RAM → NVMe SSD, with a browser dashboard and OpenAI/Anthropic-compatible APIs.
